outputs.explanation: The lower graph in panel A is a bar chart of mean HMGB1 signal intensity (Nuc/Cyto) with SD error bars across genotypes, but no individual data points (dots/circles) are overlaid despite n>100 cells being analyzed.
The lower graph in panel B is a bar chart showing mean % aggregate-positive Purkinje cells with SD error bars for each genotype, but no individual data points from the four mice per group are shown.
Panel C is a western blot image, not a quantitative plot.
Panel D is a line plot of rotarod performance over time; line plots are exempt from requiring individual data point overlays as this would make the plot unreadable.
Panel E consists of line plots of rotarod performance across days/weeks; line plots are exempt from the individual data point requirement.
Panel F is a Kaplan-Meier survival curve (a line plot type), which is exempt from requiring individual data point overlays.
Panel G shows histological micrographs, not a quantitative plot.

Both the upper (molecular layer thickness) and lower (Purkinje cell number) bar graphs show mean ± SD across nine mice per group with error bars only, but no individual data points are overlaid to show the underlying measurements.
